leave_sick_days_001.evidence: Ten days of sick leave will be granted annually with full pay.

leave_sick_accrual_002.evidence: Ten days of sick leave will be granted annually with full pay, cumulative to thirty teaching days.

leave_sick_family_003.evidence: Special use of sick leave will be reviewed by the principal, the Benefits Department, and granted by the appropriate Assistant Superintendent, in the event of serious illness of a member of the immediate family, or of any other person who is a member of the same household as the teacher.
